summary: Reactions, in two parts that work together. ReactionBar is a row of quick reactions as round buttons with the emoji large, and a more button at its end that opens the full emoji picker (parts/emoji-picker) in a popover over it; either way the emoji and its English name go to onReact, and the ones the person already gave are drawn pressed. Framed, it floats over a video or a message on a popup's look; unframed, it sits in a toolbar or a popover (ReactionPopover, which closes once a reaction is given). In a narrow room the reactions scroll sideways inside the bar while the more button stays at its end. ReactionChips are the reactions under a message: each emoji with how many gave it, yours marked, a press adding or taking back yours, and a button at the end that opens the bar to give a new one.

anatomy.bar: ReactionBar: a toolbar named words.label, as wide as its buttons and never wider than its container. Framed, on the popup's look (parts/select's popup: popover ground and ink, a 1px border-strong edge, radius-surface, elevation-pop), padded 4.
anatomy.reactions: The quick reactions in a row, 2 apart, scrolling sideways with no scroll bar when the bar is narrower than they are.
anatomy.reaction: One quick reaction: a round button with the emoji, named and titled by its English name, pressed while the person has given it.
anatomy.more: With more: the button at the bar's end, outside the scrolling row, a smile with a plus in muted-foreground, named and titled words.more. Pressed, it opens the full emoji picker in a popover over it, lined up at its end, its pick going to onReact.
anatomy.chips: ReactionChips: the reactions in a row that wraps, 4 apart, and the add button at its end. Nothing is drawn while there are no reactions and no way to add one.
anatomy.chip: One reaction: its icon or emoji, then how many gave it, on a pill a control-xs tall; marked in primary while one of them is yours. Titled by its label and named words.count; a press adds or takes back yours.
anatomy.chipCount: The count after the emoji, in the body face with tabular figures.
anatomy.add: With onReaction or onAddReaction: the add button at the chips' end, a pill like a chip holding a smile with a plus, named words.react with a tooltip saying it. With onReaction it opens the bar in a popover over it (ReactionPopover, lined up at its start), the person's own reactions pressed in it; with onAddReaction the app answers it.

onReact.does: ReactionBar: hears the emoji given, from the row or from the full list, and its English name. ReactionChips: hears a chip's id when it is pressed.

reactions.does: ReactionBar: the quick reactions, as emoji or { emoji, name }; QUICK_REACTIONS by default (red heart, thumbs up, party popper, clapping hands, face with tears of joy, face with open mouth, crying face, thinking face, thumbs down). ReactionChips: the reactions given, { id, icon, label, count, mine? }.

selected.does: ReactionBar: the emoji the person has already given, drawn pressed.

more.does: ReactionBar: offers the more button at the end.

moreOpen.does: ReactionBar: whether the full list is open, when the app holds it (moreOpen, defaultMoreOpen, onMoreOpenChange).

picker.does: ReactionBar: the full list's options (parts/emoji-picker): its recent emoji, skin tone and where it keeps them.

size.does: ReactionBar: md, buttons 36 round with the emoji at text.emoji; sm, 28 with text.base, for a message's hover bar or a tight toolbar.

framed.does: ReactionBar: draws the bar on the popup's look, to float over a video or a message; false inside a popover or a toolbar of its own. ReactionPopover sets false.

onReaction.does: ReactionChips: offers the add button, which opens the bar and its full list; hears the emoji given and its name.

onAddReaction.does: ReactionChips: offers the add button, which the app answers itself; onReaction opens the bar instead.

bar.does: ReactionChips: the bar's options: its quick reactions, words and full list.

bar.note: The pad and the popup's look only when framed.

reaction.note: md; a circle. The emoji in the emoji face.

more.note: As large as the bar's reactions, md or sm.

chip.note: The emoji in the emoji face on a line as tall as its size; an icon 14.

popoverEdge.note: A popover holding the bar or the full list keeps this far from the window's edges, and is never wider than the window less 16.

rest.means: Drawn: the quick reactions, the more button, none given.

hover.means: The pointer is over a reaction or the more button: washed hover, the more button's icon in foreground; over a chip or the add button, edged border-strong, the add button's icon in foreground.

focus.means: Keyboard focus on a reaction or the more button: the frame's focus outline in ring, focus-ring-width wide, drawn focus-ring-offset inside the circle, so a reaction already given shows it beside its pressed ring. On a chip or the add button: a focus-ring-width ring in ring at half strength around it, with no offset.

pressed.means: A quick reaction the person has given: washed primary at 12 percent, a 1 wide ring in primary at 60 percent outside it; with keyboard focus too, the focus outline inside it as well, both read.

open.means: The more button while the full list is open, the add button while the bar is: the more button washed hover, the add button edged border-strong.
open.reached: a press on it, or moreOpen

mine.means: A chip one of whose givers is the person: edged primary at 60 percent, washed primary at 12 percent, in primary-ink.

sm.means: ReactionBar at size sm: buttons 28 with text.base.

rest.note: Framed: the popup's look, elevation-pop under it. Unframed, no ground, edge or shadow of its own.
A circle; no ground at rest.

keyboard.does: Moves to the bar's button before or after, the more button included; it stops at the first and the last, as every list of choices does.
keyboard.when: a button of the bar has focus

keyboard.does: Gives the reaction, or opens the full list from the more button.
keyboard.when: a button of the bar has focus

keyboard.does: Adds or takes back the person's reaction, or opens the bar from the add button.
keyboard.when: a chip or the add button has focus

keyboard.does: Closes the full list or ReactionPopover, focus back on the button that opened it; with a query in the list's search, clears it first.
keyboard.when: a popover of the bar is open

appText.reactions: Each chip's icon and label; a quick reaction's name when the app gives its own list.
appText.picker: The full list's words are parts/emoji-picker's, passed through the bar's words.picker.

sokkel-ui: The bar's and the add button's popovers are Base UI's Popover, which takes Escape and a press outside and puts focus back on the trigger; the list starts loading as the pointer reaches a trigger or it takes focus (loadEmojiData).
The quick reactions scroll in a row with scrollbar-width none; the more button sits outside it.
toggleReaction and mineOf are helpers an app may use to apply a reaction to its list: the count moves by one, a reaction no one gives any more is dropped, a new one is added at the end.

drift.today: As of 48f51ce there is no reaction bar or reaction chips.
